name: Work Permit (Carte de Séjour Portant Autorisation de Travail)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a Tunisian employer's job offer and a work-authorization component attached to the residence card (carte de séjour portant la mention 'autorisation de travail'), issued after Ministry of Employment review.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Tunisian employer willing to sponsor the work-authorization process.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must generally demonstrate no suitable Tunisian candidate was available for the role.

outcome.duration_length: not specified precisely in the sources located in this build; typically renewed annually alongside the residence card

sources.title: Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie Tuniso-Française (bilateral trade chamber, private) -- process overview for the carte de séjour and attached work authorization: employer-sponsored, subject to Ministry of Employment review and a general local-recruitment test
